task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the SEB Server using super-admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SEB Server dashboard or configuration list is visible, indicating a successful login.

task_completion.description: A new configuration is created with the specific name 'ENGL101_Creative_Writing_2026'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'ENGL101_Creative_Writing_2026' is typed into the configuration name field.

task_completion.description: The spell checking feature is enabled in the browser settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkbox or toggle for 'Allow spell checking' or 'Enable spell check' is checked/active.

task_completion.description: The text zoom feature is enabled in the browser settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkbox or toggle for 'Allow text zoom' or 'Enable text zoom' is checked/active.

task_completion.description: The printing feature is disabled in the browser settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A checkbox or toggle for 'Allow printing' is unchecked/disabled.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the configuration changes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks a 'Save', 'Create', or 'Update' button, and a success message or the updated list appears.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation or scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the SEB Server web UI elements.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the menu rather than jumping to a final success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from login to settings to save.

integrity.description: The configuration name was typed or pasted into the correct UI field.
integrity.visual_evidence: The name 'ENGL101_Creative_Writing_2026' appears within the designated input box in the browser.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The configuration must be named exactly 'ENGL101_Creative_Writing_2026'. The required settings are: Spell Check = Enabled, Text Zoom = Enabled, and Printing = Disabled. The agent must use the credentials super-admin / admin on the local SEB Server at http://localhost:8080.
